item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i gnas 'dren ngan song dong sprug
item.coloph: zhes gnas 'dren ngan song don (dong) sprag zhes bya ba/ sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems pa gser gyi nyi ma/ rigs drug thar par 'dren pa thugs rje'i lcags kyu/ sdig can mi rnams btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'di nyid/ sprul pa'i sku mchog snyigs ma lnga bdo'i gdul (bya 'dul) ba'i 'gro mgon tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen po nyid kyi rjes 'breng*/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am gsang ba'i ming ni drung mu thogs med rtsal/ snyigs dus rnal 'byor g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pa bdag la/ dmu gzhung khal dmar du dbyar sgar skabs su brgyud kyang / res zhig btang snyoms su bzhag rung / dmu tha g.yul 'gyed 'khrugs pa'i skabs su phan par shar tshe/ dad sbyin rnams kyi sku rim stong bzlog sgrub skabs su/ la 'dus gdongs mtsher bar ma sug bris bgyis pa/ 'gro kun thar lam phyed cing*/ yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
